scope: Offline explicit node schedules and local temporal predicates; no geometry-derived arrivals or controller acceptance
source: AT NODE[n/*] and TIME integer-expression BEFORE/AFTER NODE[n/*], captured in local WHEN/UNTIL predicates only
schedule: Explicit response node_times and delay_ms; node zero at zero, complete selected destinations, monotone integer times, final arrival at delay
boundaries: NODE[0] starts the move; non-path NODE[1] ends it; path ranges keep original indexes; BEFORE clamps to the preceding segment start, BEFORE zero and AFTER final never fire
wildcard: Selected destination nodes only, excluding zero; independent one-shot clauses can match later wildcard events after earlier gate misses
capture: Offset then node expression once at definition, after existing EVAL captures; strict integer bounds and existing counter protection
progress: Exact declared/event breakpoints within the cooperative progress loop; globals first, local source order, constant-time event lookup and bounded cursor advancement
lifetime: Pause/hold freezes progress; resume preserves event maps; cancellation/abort/failure retain checked cleanup and distinguish declared future arrivals from reached progress
history: Optional execution node_times and concrete conditions with strict admission/restore checks; no pending restoration or active saves
